skill.summary: 输入文字或图片，通过混元生3D 3.0、3.1 模型，生成更高精度以及更高质量的3D 模型，支持文生3D，图生3D，多视图生3D，单几何生成（白模），草图生3D，智能拓扑生3D功能。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of hy-3d-generation v1.0.0

- Enables text or image input to generate high-quality 3D models using Tencent Cloud Hunyuan 3D models (versions 3.0 & 3.1).
- Supports multiple modes: text-to-3D, image-to-3D, multi-view images, sketch-to-3D, geometry-only (white model), and smart topology.
- Offers multiple script workflows (one-step, submit/query by job ID) and output formats (OBJ, GLB, STL, USDZ, FBX).
- Includes automatic dependency installation and credential detection.
- Provides detailed configuration and execution instructions for end users and agents.
